answered.sql: SELECT scuba_center_id, type FROM Bookings JOIN Dive_Sites ON Bookings.dive_site_id = Dive_Sites.id GROUP BY scuba_center_id, type

candidates.meaning: List the types of dive sites available at each scuba diving center.
candidates.sql: SELECT scuba_center_id, type FROM Bookings JOIN Dive_Sites ON Bookings.dive_site_id = Dive_Sites.id GROUP BY scuba_center_id, type

candidates.meaning: List the types of dive sites available at each scuba diving center.
candidates.sql: SELECT sdc.name, ds.type FROM Scuba_Diving_Centers sdc JOIN Bookings b ON sdc.id = b.scuba_center_id JOIN Dive_Sites ds ON ds.id = b.dive_site_id GROUP BY sdc.name, ds.type

candidates.meaning: Count the number of different dive sites available at each scuba diving center.
candidates.sql: SELECT sdc.name, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.type) AS num_types FROM Scuba_Diving_Centers sdc JOIN Bookings b ON sdc.id = b.scuba_center_id JOIN Dive_Sites ds ON ds.id = b.dive_site_id GROUP BY sdc.name

candidates.meaning: Identify the most common type of dive site available at each scuba diving center.
candidates.sql: SELECT sdc.name, ds.type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM Scuba_Diving_Centers sdc JOIN Bookings b ON sdc.id = b.scuba_center_id JOIN Dive_Sites ds ON ds.id = b.dive_site_id GROUP BY sdc.name, ds.type ORDER BY sdc.name, count DESC LIMIT 1
